description: This bar chart, from the paper “RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining,” compares the performance of three Korean language models—RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six evaluation benchmarks: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The horizontal axis lists these benchmarks in order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents performance scores, scaled linearly from 0 to 1.00, with tick marks appearing at every 0.20 increment. For each benchmark, three bars are grouped side-by-side: the leftmost bar (dark purple) represents RedWhale (our), the middle bar (light blue) represents EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and the rightmost bar (light gray) represents SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). The exact performance values are labeled directly above each bar. For PT-EVAL, RedWhale scores 0.42, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.46, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) scores 1.00. For KoBEST-BQ, RedWhale scores 0.52, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.56, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) scores 1.00. For KoBEST-CP, RedWhale scores 0.71, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.74, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) scores 1.00. For KoBEST-HS, RedWhale scores 0.50, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.54, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) scores 1.00. For KoBEST-SN, RedWhale scores 0.69, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.73, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) scores 1.00. For the AVG benchmark, RedWhale scores 0.57, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 scores 0.61, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) scores 1.00. The bars are not sorted by value, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the standard labeling and color coding.
